meta.data_source: FRED (VIXCLS, DTWEXBGS, GOLDAMGBD228NLBM, DGS10) + Frankfurter (ECB FX)

starting_state.composition: 7-component Strategic Prior (USD 27% / EUR 20% / JPY 9% / GBP 8% / CNY 5% / CHF 5% / Gold 26%)
starting_state.base_fixings: Rebased to first backtest day's actual FX/gold (so I_0 = 1.0 represents basket value on day 1)

invariants: INV-1  RR >= 1.00 (RR_HARD absolute solvency floor — I2)

INV-2  P_MTQ in [0.50, 2.00] (§3.5 safety band — circuit breaker). P_MTQ drift from PAR is INFORMATIONAL: MTQ is PAR-referenced (not USD-pegged). Gold appreciation lifts P_MTQ — correct purchasing-power behavior.
INV-3  No state reaches EMERGENCY and stays there >48h without recovery (Listing 13)
INV-4  Oracle consensus >=3 sources valid for >=99% of ticks (strict I9)
INV-5  Chain-linked index diverges <5% from the actual basket value (Laspeyres)
meta.peg_stability_definition: P_MTQ in [0.50, 2.00] (§3.5 safety band) at every day. Drift from PAR is informational (PAR-referenced, not USD-pegged).
meta.safety_band_definition: P_MTQ in [0.50, 2.00] (§3.5 hard circuit breaker) at every day

degradedReasons: VIX: FRED returned no observations (using seeded default)
DXY: FRED returned no observations (using seeded default)
Treasury: FRED returned no observations (using default)

INV1_rrHard.description: RR >= 1.00 (RR_HARD) at every day — min RR observed = 1.0808

INV2_pppBand.description: P_MTQ in [0.50, 2.00] (§3.5 safety band) — in-band 100.00% of ticks. P_MTQ drift is informational (PAR-referenced).

INV3_emergency48h.description: No EMERGENCY streak > 48h — max streak = 0 days

INV4_oracleConsensus.description: Oracle consensus >=3 sources — valid 100.00% of ticks

INV5_indexDivergence.description: Chain-linked I_t vs Laspeyres L_t divergence < 5% — max = 10.244%

safetyBand.description: P_MTQ in [0.50, 2.00] (§3.5 hard safety band) — in-band 100.00% of ticks (informational)
